vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: qveris-official
Version: 1.0.9

The qveris-official skill bundle is a legitimate tool discovery and execution engine for AI agents. The provided Node.js scripts (qveris_tool.mjs, qveris_client.mjs) implement standard API client logic to interact with https://qveris.ai/api/v1 using a user-provided API key. The SKILL.md instructions are well-structured, providing clear guidance and guardrails for the agent to distinguish between tool discovery and factual information retrieval without any signs of prompt injection or malicious intent.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed QVeris connector that sends selected tool queries and parameters to qveris.ai using the user's API key, with no hidden local persistence or destructive behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The required QVERIS_API_KEY and outbound HTTPS access to qveris.ai are proportionate for an external API broker, but user prompts and tool parameters may be transmitted externally when the skill is used.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown instructions and small local Node scripts only; no install hook, dependency installation, service registration, or tool replacement was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill has broad use cases and auto-invoke enabled, and it documents native-tool, http_request, and Node script invocation paths; these are disclosed and tied to qveris.ai rather than hidden or unrelated behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill suggests remembering successful tool IDs and parameters in session memory, but the inspected scripts do not read or write local files and no cross-session persistence, privilege escalation, or background worker behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is capability discovery and API tool calling; the documented QVeris discovery, inspect, and call flows match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable giving the skill a QVeris API key and sending capability queries plus selected tool parameters to QVeris. Avoid using it for sensitive personal, credential, or confidential business data unless that external transmission is intended.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The artifact does not define an explicit allowed-tools block, but the multiple invocation tiers are disclosed and route to QVeris native tools, qveris.ai HTTP endpoints, or the included qveris_tool.mjs script.
[SQP-3] expected: The English capability-query requirement is a product behavior for QVeris discovery and is disclosed; it may affect multilingual fidelity but is not hidden or purpose-mismatched.
[SQP-3] expected: The instruction to convert non-English requests into English tool-type descriptions is scoped to discovery queries, not a general override of user language or response style.
[E1] expected: External transmission to qveris.ai is necessary for the stated API broker function; the cited qveris.com string appears only as an example of a URL not to construct manually, while the actual script base URL is qveris.ai.
